title: Observation batch
description: Request body for POST /observations. Per ADR-0002 there is no batch header: every observation carries a full envelope and the repetition is absorbed by request-level gzip, so a batch is simply a list. Wrapped in an object rather than sent as a bare array so the request can gain optional fields additively without a breaking change.

observations.description: Clients chunk their outbox to this bound. The server processes each item independently: one invalid observation is quarantined (validated=false) and never fails the batch, because a single bad record must not block delivery of good ones from a field site.

$comment: The $ref is relative rather than absolute on purpose. Because every contract's $id mirrors its path in the tree, a relative reference resolves identically two ways: as a file path for plain tooling that reads the repository, and as a URI relative to this schema's $id for anything resolving over the network. Absolute refs work only for the second.
